THIS CASE IS NOT IN KHIS YET

Afiax couldn't submit it to KHIS. It will try again every hour, and you won't get another email when it does. Until then, this email is the notification: follow your usual IDSR reporting for this case.

The patient's name, ID numbers, contact details and address are left out to protect them. Staff at Kisumu Lakeside Hospital can see the full record in Afiax.

WHAT TO DO NOW

1. Contact Kisumu Lakeside Hospital to confirm the case and get the case details you need.

2. Follow the IDSR technical guidelines for Cholera: case investigation, specimen collection for laboratory confirmation, and control measures.

3. Pass it on to the sub-county or county surveillance coordinator if that isn't you.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

If more cases of Cholera are recorded, each one gets its own notification. If several come close together, you may also get a separate outbreak alert.

QUESTIONS?
